heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 98–473, title II, § 609B(e), (l), Oct. 12, 1984, 98 Stat. 2093, 2096

notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 90–351, title I, § 819, as added Pub. L. 96–157, § 2, Dec. 27, 1979, 93 Stat. 1213, authorized acceptance of voluntary services. See section 10226(g) of Title 34, Crime Control and Law Enforcement.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective Oct. 12, 1984, see section 609AA(a) of Pub. L. 98–473, set out as an Effective Date note under section 10101 of Title 34, Crime Control and Law Enforcement.
